trigger: Use when writing, changing, moving or reviewing a repository's documentation, even when the request is a code change that makes a page untrue, or only asks to save a plan, a review or a note.

includes: what a page may describe, and where planned work lives
keeping the reason beside the rule
updating documentation in the same commit as the code
where the documentation index and the repository's own documentation convention live
the order between these rules, the repository's convention and the documentation recommendations
excludes: how the text of a page is written
which folder a page goes in, and a site's front matter
agent instruction files, changelogs and capsule content
